visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men stand in front of a large, colorful Pokémon Mezastar display. The man on the right, the main character, wears a light grey hoodie and glasses, gesturing excitedly with his hands. The man on the left wears a dark grey zip-up hoodie. The setting is a brightly lit event area with vibrant purple and yellow lighting. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor arcade environment where several red and blue Pokémon Mezastar machines are lined up. The main character points enthusiastically at the colorful screens which display game graphics. (3) Sitting at the machine, the main character holds a silver coin and inserts it into the coin slot. He is dressed in the same light grey hoodie and jeans. (4) He holds up various white and purple plastic game tokens to the camera, including a detailed close-up of a Glaceon token. (5) The two men play the game together, rapidly pressing large circular buttons on the console. The lighting is bright and even across the indoor space. (6) The main character holds up high-tier tokens featuring Zamazenta and Mewtwo, smiling widely at the camera.

(4) [Subtitle]: 沒錯!現在全台 900 多個地點都能玩到 Pokémon MEZASTAR!. (5) [Subtitle]: 是冰伊布!超可愛的. (6) [Slogan]: 加入 SEGA Taiwan 卡片遊戲 LINE 官方帳號 領取訓練家 ID 讓遊戲更有趣!. (7) [Subtitle]: 倒下吧! OK 贏了!. (8) [Subtitle]: 哇是白蓬蓬!太好了. (9) [Subtitle]: 各位太扯了!直接30塊出藏瑪然特. (10) [Subtitle]: 哇啊真的是超夢!超帥的喔!. (11) [Subtitle]: 4月2號開始全台 900 多個地點都能挑戰喔.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic male voice delivers a rapid introduction over an upbeat electronic background track featuring steady drum patterns and bright synthesizer textures. The acoustic environment is a clean studio-style mix with minimal background noise. (2) A metallic 'clink' sound occurs as a coin is inserted into a slot, followed immediately by the rapid rhythmic clicking sounds of physical arcade buttons being pressed. The speaker's arousal level rises significantly, punctuating the play with excited exclamations. (3) Multiple high-frequency digital UI sound effects from the game machine, such as 'dings' and synthesized impact noises, layer over the driving BGM beat. The narrator's vocal intensity remains high, expressing excitement and joy through loud projection. (4) The audio sequence concludes with a mix of celebratory voices and sharp transitional 'whoosh' sound effects, while the BGM maintains its energetic tempo and major tonality.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the Pokémon Mezastar game in Taiwan by demonstrating its gameplay, highlighting the excitement of winning rare tokens, and informing viewers about the availability of machines at over 900 locations including 7-Eleven stores.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is centered around playing and promoting the Pokémon Mezastar game, featuring clear brand logos and a call to action to join a LINE official account.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly energetic promotional vlog designed for social media, utilizing fast-paced editing and vibrant colors to appeal to Pokémon fans and gamers.
